text: NOAA CPC's discussion of 12 November 2026 keeps an El Niño Advisory: El Niño continues to strengthen, with a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January–March 2027 (a greater than 79% chance), and is expected to begin weakening in early 2027. The next discussion is scheduled for 10 December 2026.
NOAA puts the chance of a historic event, with a 3-month RONI of +2.5 °C or more, at about 60% for October–December and November–January.
